features.text: Strategic patella padding provides extra protection for sensitive kneecap area
Therapeutic compression promotes circulation and reduces joint discomfort
Soft, breathable materials ensure comfortable extended wear
Easy-care construction - simply wash with mild detergent and air dry
Lightweight design fits discreetly under clothing while maintaining support

measurement: For optimal comfort and support, measure the circumference of your knee at the center of the patella. Visit our Perfect Fit Promise page for detailed sizing guidance and expert fitting assistance.
